title: Session Summaries (part 3)
content:
Session 15 - “Demogorgon” 1/17/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib, Azaelith

  • The Party continued to slosh around in everyone's favorite place, Sloobludop, the city of the kuo-toa.
  • Daterra noticed one of Bav's Lornlings. She gave it a femur and a snake fang, and it hopped away.
  • The Party went to the house of Ploo, the Archpriest of the Sea Mother to plan for the upcoming sacrificial offering that night (we called him "Papa" instead of a name that sounded too much like “poo-poo-pee-pee”). They strategized with him, his son Glug (we called him "the Son"), and a dozen other kuo-toa. They planned to tie up the PCs and give them to the Archpriest's evil daughter Blopp, the Archpriestess of the Deep Father (we called her "the Daughter"), as bait. The kuo-toas kept the Party's larger equipment like swords and tied them all up loosely. Sig was off on his own the whole time, disguised as a fish lady (DM shakes his head).
  • At the Offering, a massive crowd gathered like a school of fish in constant motion. The Party saw the creepy Archpriestess Daughter and her second-in-command Klib (we called him "Ax"). The Party was lined up by the altar and held by guards.
  • A duergar (gray dwarf) named Hemeth was pushed forward to be sacrificed first. Before Papa and his men were in position, Jibjib jumped the gun, intervening and shooting his "Careless Whispers" spell to save Hemeth.
  • All hell broke loose, with the PCs scrambling to get free of their restraints and shake off the guards holding them. Daughter Archpriestess and Papa Archpriest began water-bending with powerful Control Water spells, one trying to bring the Darklake shore crashing onto the crowd, the other pushing the water back. The crowd of hundreds of kuo-toa began swarming and fighting each other.
  • The Party noticed glowing light coming from out below the water and all up along the rock walls and ceiling of the vast cavern around the city. They recognized it as another Rift area like the others they'd encountered before. Sig realized this was called "faerzress", a natural unstable magical anomaly found in places throughout the Underdark. Something had been exacerbating this instability lately, opening up portals to other planes.
  • They also noticed the water rising and moving. And, unrelated to that, deadly manta ray-like creatures began attacking any kuo-toa walking out in the water, pulling them under and ripping them to shreds.
  • The fight turned deadly, with multiple characters coming close to death and the Party getting split up among the moshing crowd of fish-folk. Simply moving triggered countless attacks of opportunity. (But the DM had a whole night of shit rolls! You’re welcome!)
  • And then something rose up from the Darklake. The Offering ritual combined with all the death from the massive battle succeeded in completing what the followers of the Deep Father had been trying to complete – they summoned their dark lord. Demogorgon, Prince of Demons, a thirty-foot-tall two-headed monstrosity with god-like stats, thrashing tentacles, and an insatiable lust to destroy everything that moves. The Party had just a few rounds of combat before this demon lord reached the shore.
  • Half of the Party fled for the docks to escape through the Rift by boat. Demogorgon's tentacles crashed into the boat a few times, nearly capsizing them and sending deadly waves that nearly killed some of them.
  • The other half went back to get Shrump and Snoodle before leaving. The duergar Hemeth pleaded to be rescued, so Perry carried him along, saving the dwarf's life. This half of the Party then reached their own boat and went out toward the Rift.
  • We learned that both Kronk and Daterra had a lot of experience with boats, each piloting their respective group out into the water to safety.
  • Both groups successfully managed to gather everyone and jump into the Rift. The entire Party made it, along with Glug the son of Papa Archpriest, and Hemeth the duergar.
  • They fell through time and space, and once again Sig became the one to steer them, solidifying his place as the “Rift master” (your words not mine). Sig chose to send them to the Inn at the End of the Road in Hither.
  • They fell from the sky onto the rooftops of both the Inn and Bavlorna's Cottage! Someone had parked the Inn right next to Bav's house in Downfall since the last time they were here.
  • As they landed, they noticed an extra character fell out of the Rift with them! An elf-like man with strange dark afflictions on his body, a sword at his side, a pocket watch, strange clothing, and a striking resemblance to people both Kronk and Daterra had met in their backstories. He seemed utterly insane and confused about where he was, but he recognized Kronk, he got excited about Perry's marbles and the potential for power they apparently held, and he knew he was meant to give something to the Party. He handed over a strange puzzle device called The Harptos Eight Name box...

Session 14 - “Sloobludop” 12/6/24

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib


  • Towards the end of combat with the gnolls, the Shaman ripped out the throat of the gnoll Pack Lord and began chanting and performing a strange demonic ritual. The Party saw glimpses of some dog-like demonic entity in their minds, its attention drawn to this area by the ritual. The Shaman began raising the dead gnolls throughout the tunnels. The Party was able to defeat the Shaman and the other remaining gnolls before more undead could be raised.
  • The Party gained quite a bit of good loot from the gnolls.
  • They then found a safe place to rest, where Kronk, Sig, and Daterra had more plot development through dreams (Discord). This included Bav talking to Daterra and starting to call your Party ‘Bavlorna’s Bloodhounds’, as well as Kronk and Shuushar speaking together in Kronk’s dream.
  • While the others slept, the unlikely pair Jibjib and Perry were on watch. They hopped and splashed about to pass the time, starting to develop a friendship bond. And together they started to discover more about Perry’s marbles and background. There was a conspiracy, where Perry had witnessed something, and someone intentionally scattered his memories in the form of marbles. 
  • Sig cooked up a frog he found inside Banksy the Cat of Holding, and Jibjib was none too pleased.
  • The Party lucked out during the 6 days of travel to the Darklake, Daterra producing plenty of food and helping guide them safely with no encounters.
  • Finally they reached the kuo-toa city Sloobludop, marvelling at its glowing coral-like architecture and laughing at its strange fish-folk people. Shuushar helped get them welcomed safely through the huge net-walls guarding the city.
  • In town, the Party enjoyed a rowdy and weird day of shopping, fishing, and absurd chaos. There was an inn for sleep walking called the Biding Tide. An arcane shop called the Silted Soul with a well-meaning shopkeep unknowingly selling fake magic items. A weapons and armor shop called Bubbles & Barbs with a shopkeep that acted ‘fishy’. In a group effort, Perry and Daterra, along with Jibjib and Shuushar helping translate, sweet-talked their way into the most generous discounts possible, although it resulted in the shopkeep carving a strange symbol on Daterra’s forehead and requesting she go to the ‘offering’ later that night. Oh and Sig made some cajun jerky…
  • Leading up to the ominous culty offering at an altar with a disgusting octopus shrine, the Archpriest of the Sea Mother intercepted them. His name was… no we’ll just say ‘the Archpriest’. He told them his daughter had recently named herself Archpriestess of a strange new god called the Deep Father, and the city has become divided. He asked the Party for help infiltrating and stopping these dangerous new cultists by acting as bait during the upcoming blood sacrifice…

Session 13 - “Gnolls” 11/15/24

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib, Azaelith


  • With a cave-in behind them, and terrifying Hook Horrors bursting out in front of them, the Party rolls Initiative. A pack of cackling blood-thirsty gnolls is in the middle of hunting a pair of Hook Horrors.
  • The Hook Horrors defend themselves and end up escaping down a narrow tunnel as the gnolls focus their attention on the Party.
  • Many gnolls are killed, including archers and hunters, a special raging gnoll with a battle axe, and a hulking gnoll brute.
  • Hyena-like laughs and barks and the sounds of combat echo throughout the winding maze of tunnels as the fight continues. It quickly becomes a game of cat and mouse, with the pack of gnolls hunting the players. Stealth vs stealth, tactical combat within close quarters and tight corners, large rocks providing cover and ambush spots, and even Jibjib and Daterra Spider-Climbing on the damn ceiling!
  • The Party sees possibly the most success in the campaign thus far, with expert teamwork, slashing swords, stealth and daggers, clutch healing, and masterful use of spells like Entangle, Moonbeam, and Hunger of Hadar.
  • Perry becomes a pincushion for gnoll arrows, but he takes it like a good paladin tank should.
  • After clearing out most of the tunnels, they encounter a horrific shaman-like gnoll holding a smoking skull and a bloody heart. He and a couple other hiding gnolls try to ambush the Party, but Sig uses Cause Fear on the creepy Shaman.
  • The last remaining gnolls retreat, but the Party isn’t out of the woods yet. With nowhere else to go, they follow the fleeing gnolls, hoping to put an end to this deadly encounter. 


Session 12 - “Puzzling Tunnels” 10/25/24

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib, Azaelith


  • Continuing the labyrinthine fey puzzle, the Party triggered a number of wild magic effects. Daterra breathed flames, Perry grew an eye on the back of his neck, and Kronk’s hair fell out. A fog cloud also obscured their vision, and they soon realized something was in the tunnels with them. 
  • A strange cat spoke to the Party from the shadows, only ever saying the word “love” in different languages. It tested them, by having them tell about their families and backstories. In return, the cat answered questions and gave hints about the puzzle. 
  • Jibjib was revealed to be only 12 years old! He had been abandoned as a baby, was found by Papa Jib (30), cleverly named Jibjib, had an Uncle Krum (28), and no other relatives of note.
  • Azaelith told of the destruction of his home town, a kobold village in the mountains far to the east. His family had been out fishing when mercenaries attacked. His father Draco and his mother died trying to protect his two younger sisters. Azaelith and his older brother Valarian were the only survivors, each unaware of the other’s escape. Sig laughed a little too hard at Azaelith’s blunt retelling of this tale.
  • Kronk told of growing up in an abusive household, an only child with mean evil orc parents that looked much more scarred and savage than him. Kronk didn’t share their names because he was happy to forget them anyway. He’d been excited to leave them behind and forge his own path in life.
  • Sig told of how years ago his hometown, the deep gnome city of Blingdenstone, was destroyed by drow. Sig’s wife, son, and daughter were all killed.
  • Perry told of having a large rabbitfolk family but only remembering vague snippets and little nostalgic things about them all. Since losing his marbles, his memories have been very foggy. Perry also realized that the past 30 days or so in particular were completely missing from his memory.
  • Daterra reluctantly told of her deep bond with someone named Jasper.
  • The cat turned out to be a Sphinx of Wonder, the familiar of some unknown fey, placed in the tunnel to help trap demons with a puzzle and magic circle. A demon could not love, so the cat tested if people were demons by having them tell of family they loved. The cat’s name was Links or Lynx or just Love Cat. 
  • Jibjib was able to persuade the cat to share about itself. It possibly had two different masters, one described as a “thin” male fey, and the other was Zybilna. Jibjib also figured out the correlations between the puzzle’s magic circle and the one they found at the Slanty Tower back in the feywild. Whoever was making these circles probably had powerful magic items and seemed to know quite a bit about defeating demons. All signs led to it being Zybilna herself or at least her staff at the Palace of Heart’s Desire. 
  • Daterra was able to make a significant bond with the Sphinx, giving it the pink color from her hair, previously acquired from Chips the pixie, to make the constellation markings on the cat’s legs glow pink. The Sphinx wanted to come along with her, but was bound to serve its own master and stay at the magic circle.
  • The worst moment of the tunnel puzzle happened when a lightning effect was triggered. Sig and Kronk each had to secretly assign 3 lightning bolts to different party members. Daterra managed to dive in front of one heading for Snoodle. Perry, Azaelith, and Shuushar each took a bolt. And poor Nira Nestfoot, the newest member of the group, a little halfling cleric from the feywild, took two full blasts. She was killed instantly.
  • Kronk felt bad, and Sig was affected by a bit of “madness” from the guilt and shock.
  • Afterward, the Party took a solemn moment of rest to bury the halfling, using her staff as a tombstone. They watched as vines began to entwine the staff as the feywild began its process of reclaiming her soul.
  • Jibjib healed Shuushar after the lightning damage, their friendship strengthening.
  • In the end, the answer to the frustrating puzzle, as Azaelith was close to figuring out,  was in going backward through tunnels to deduce which were the wrong paths. 
  • The Party couldn’t wait to put the maze behind them, practically happy to head toward the snarls and cackles of gnolls echoing through the tunnels ahead. 
  • Azaelith scouted ahead stealthily, realizing the tunnels were close to collapsing. If they didn’t move now, they would be cut off and forced to backtrack through the dreaded puzzle and lose days of travel time. 
  • Everyone was forced to make snap decisions, and half the Party rushed forward, abandoning stealth in order to avoid the rocks falling from above. The others moved stealthily, taking damage from the cave-in but remaining hidden from the creatures ahead.
  • The source of the cave-ins burst out from a tight passage right in front of them: terrifying clacking vulture-like creatures with hooks for arms! And behind these hook horrors, a pack of gnolls, laughing and barking like blood-thirsty hyenas!


Session 11 - “Dreamscapes” 9/27/24

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib, Azaelith


  • The Party finally rested in a safe and secluded cavern.
  • Nira made a campfire, and Jibjib and Sig took first watch with her, all three really opening up and getting to know each other.
  • As Jibjib drifted into sleep, his telepathy and the glowing veins in the rock walls around them connected everyone in strange dreamscape vision scenes. As everyone slept, their dreams unfolded around them in the cozy cavern. Everyone could somehow see and interact with each other’s visions. 
  • Azaelith gazed into the campfire, suddenly seeing the face of his kobold brother Valerian. Azaelith tried to find out where Valerian was, but his brother was hesitant to tell him much. They discussed the elven sword from their village. Valerian had attuned to it and was using it for something, but wouldn’t say more. Fire seemed to have something to do with it all. Meanwhile a voice in Azaelith’s mind kept interjecting. The voice told Azaelith that his brother had been corrupted and changed, that he was lying, hiding things from Azaelith, that he didn’t care about him and only thought he would get in the way. Valerian felt the voice’s presence and quickly cut the connection. 
  • Daterra dreamed she was in Bavlorna’s dining room, sitting across from the hag. They had a tense conversation, Bav demanding the Party return all the stuff they took from her Cottage. Daterra (with Jibjib and others chiming in too) talked her way out of most of this, convincing Bav they NEEDED to keep items like the Frost Brand, Helm, Shield, etc for their adventure if they're going to be any use to Bav in the first place. They convinced Bav it's in her best interest to make a stronger alliance with them and help them. They also convinced her the Frog Statue GAVE them items when asked, so they didn't steal. Bav did end up blasting her eye spell at them in anger during this scene, but things went smoothly overall.
  • Sig dreamed of a luxurious night club with a cool guy sitting in the shadows drinking and smoking a cig. He introduced himself as Mr. Six, clearly hiding his true name and face. The two made an interesting pair — Mr. Six all sexy and mysterious, and Sig… sexy in his own way. Mr. Six wanted to know more about the Party and their goals, saying he can possibly help them. Sig was very open about his own goals as well as the other PCs and their Stolen Things and goals. In the end, a massive hand swept through the scene, and Mr. Six fled, ending the dream. 
  • Kronk dreamed along with Shuushar. They relived a memory of when Kronk and his elven friend Ollie bought pocket watches from a traveling merchant. The merchant spoke and dressed strangely and had weird afflictions on his skin. Daterra recognized this merchant, having met someone very similar on her own travels. Kronk and Shuushar made a stronger bond, hoping to continue dream-mentoring like this to unravel the mysteries around Ollie.
  • Perry played with his marbles. He learned the marbles glow when close to certain things and even Party members. He swallowed a marble and the glow went completely dim. Later when using his Divine Sense ability, this glow was amplified, as if he might be able to learn to use the two together.
  • Jibjib dreamed he was in a cozy house staring out the window at a raging storm. The storm depicted a colossal monster with countless teeth trying to devour a man in a boat. Inside the cozy house was an unseen male figure resting with Jibjib. This man gave Jib advice about fighting the drow followers of Lolth. Jibjib then tried to will himself to help the man outside in the boat. Jib suddenly saw through this man’s eyes, seeing his dark skin and lean muscles. Jib helped row the boat away from the gnashing teeth, influencing the scene in favor of the man in the boat.  
  • After a night of baffling dreams and visions, the Party continued their travels through the unending tunnels of the Underdark. They moved safely and quietly, hearing different things from the many forks in the paths ahead. 
  • The tunnel they chose led to a bizarre scene — a cavern filled with plants and mushrooms that had spilled out from a feywild rift. In the center of the cave was an ominous pentagram magic circle. The Party learned a fey had warded this area against demons, blocking the way forward with a confusing puzzle of different tunnels. 
  • The Party started to test out the many paths. Some tunnels led back to the entrance, while others triggered wild magic effects like Invisibility and a Charm effect that made them attack one another. 
  • Growing impatient and worn out, the Party ended the session back at the entrance of the puzzle, scratching their heads in confusion. 

Session 10 - “Booty” 8/23/24

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib, Azaelith

Before session 11, level up to Level 4!


  • Leading into this session, Azaelith had a mysterious dream encounter. He awoke to find himself tied up on a table, getting healed then slapped and choked by Jaezred “Daddy Drow” Millithor and a quaggoth. Kinky.
  • Jaezred wanted to prove himself by being the one to get answers about a “relic” and some “other kobold”. Azaelith gave up nothing and slipped from his restraints.
  • Topsy and Turvy came rushing in, trying to distance themselves from the Party so they couldn’t hurt anyone during their mysterious transformation into raging beasts of some sort. The quaggoth fought the young gnomes, but they were invulnerable to damage!
  • Jaezred KO’d Azaelith and tried running off with him. Aiden took over playing as the raging/transforming Topsy and Turvy, easily killing the quaggoth.
  • When the Party came rushing in, Jaezred tried carrying Azaelith off. And he nearly got away with him, but with Topsy and Turvy on his heels, Jaezred had to drop Azaelith to get away safely. So Daddy Drow and the two young gnomes are still out there somewhere. 
  • Meanwhile the rest of the Party fought giant spiders in the Shrine Room. Sig drew the spiders’ attention from Perry, allowing him to escape the webs he had been stuck in. Sig then tried giving the cursed gems back to the shrine statue, which did nothing. Jibjib finally did some big damage. They all got a strange dark feeling from something on the dead drow Shaiir Vandree (Ilvara’s mohawk boy-toy / 2nd-in-command). But Kronk yeeted the drow body out the window at the spiders, so problem solved.
  • They let Priestess Ilvara get away rather than prolong risky combat with her. Ilvara regrouped with her dwindling forces, and they fled Velkynvelve to fight another day.
  • The Party looted the Barracks, the Guard Tower, many of the dead drow bodies, Asha the dead bald priestess, and Charm the darkling that had been talking to Bav before falling into the portal and dying in a fight with the drow. They also looted the stuff falling from Bav’s Cottage into the Shrine Room. This included a wishbone in a jar with chicken legs. Azaelith touched the wishbone back together, and it spoke in Bav’s voice telling of her sister Skabatha’s weakness. Kronk got a helmet from a dead animated armor. Sig got a spool of thread in the color of frustration and self-doubt. And everyone took turns shoving their hands down the mouth of a big Bronze Frog Statue (kinky) to pull out items they requested, some of which were very powerful magical items.
  • Daterra took some drow drug called Ziran / “Bloodfast” and got slightly addicted to it, requiring more within 5 days to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
  • Azaelith’s shadow started acting strangely, moving on its own and occasionally taking the shape of a spider. He learned he can command it to touch and move things. Kronk’s brain melted witnessing this.
  • Azaelith offered to take the cursed gems from Sig… and the curse was somehow finally broken! Not suspicious at all.
  • The Party found a Feywild halfling named Nira Nestfoot in a cage. Azaelith freed her, and she explained she was searching for her daughter who had been kidnapped by the Hags. She was mugged by Agdon Longscarf and sent to Bavlorna, who thought of her as a rival and was preparing to eat her Nira suspects. The high-spirited halfling was a Nature Cleric of King Oberon, Lord of Beasts and consort of Queen Titania of the Summer Court in the Feywild. Nira thought Titania too passive, but liked how Oberon wanted to fight back against the Hags that had corrupted the Feywild. 
  • At first Nira was scared of Perry, a harengon like Agdon, but tensions were eased and she asked to tag along with the Party just long enough to find a way back to the Feywild. (Behind the scenes, I didn’t expect her to be in the Underdark. It just played out that way. She wasn’t expected to be a party member, but she ended up falling through the portal and needs a way back. Shrug.)
  • Azaelith flashed his cloak open to show Nira his daggers. Kinky.
  • Finally the Party left Velkynvelve, hopefully for real this time. They went northwest, in the direction of the Darklake and Shuushar’s home city of Sloobludop. Shrump also told Daterra he could guide them by vibes past the Darklake to his home of Neverlight Grove.
  • The Party traveled the tunnels a bit and found a safe cavern to take a long rest. Sig figured out Banksy the cat is a non-living taxidermy construct of many creatures stitched together, and her mouth could be carefully wrenched open to reveal an extradimensional space. Basically the cat was a Bag of Holding that might attack you anytime you try to open it. Inside Sig found 3 potions with labels in Elvish he couldn’t understand. 
  • During the rest, Perry and Nira had a heart-to-heart, where he said he hoped to help her get back to the Feywild and find her daughter. He also tried to explain the complicated relationship with Agdon, but Nira still doesn’t like the thug after what he did to her. Nira gave Perry a Sending Stone in case they get separated. 
  • The Party used the long rest to inspect all the booty they got from Velkynvelve. And then everyone drifted into much-needed sleep…

Session 9 - “The Shrine Room Shitshow” 7/12/24

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib, Azaelith


  • All combat session
  • The Party got these descriptions at the start:
    • As you fall through the void, vibrant feywild colors mix with the blackness of the Underdark in a violent vortex. A raging tornado of rubble and debris from Bav’s Cottage crashes around you.
    • As you fall, dreamlike visions flash before your eyes, recent events seem to scream all around, echoing voices and sounds, distorted and slowed in time seem to hang on the air around Velkynvelve:
    • The vision shows some of the remaining drow guards dragging a struggling drow toward the edge above the spiderwebs, showing him being stripped of his equipment, a drow of importance pausing to inspect something interesting he finds. The voice of Priestess Ilvara saying, “We find you, Jorlan Duskryn, guilty and sentence you to death.” The guilty drow is the scarred drow that helped you escape by luring demons to attack Velkynvelve in Session 1.
    • The vision shows Jorlan thrown down into the webs to be instantly attacked by giant spiders, spun up in webbing and viciously torn apart limb by limb as he screams, “No it wasn’t me, it was the prisoners, they’re the murderers!!”
    • Another vision, Priestess Ilvara’s shrill voice heard shouting orders, “Were they found?” A guard responds, “No ma’am they vanished, the faerzress, those strange portals opened again.” Ilvara screeches, “Find them and kill them, we cannot afford further failure!”
    • Then the visions end as you come tumbling out of the glowing walls in the hollow stalactite, the portal vomits you out into the cold dark drow quarters!
    • Half of Bav’s Cottage, and everything inside, seems to be crashing out of several other glowing portal areas throughout Velkynvelve too! You hear all sorts of things happening above you and outside and in the distance. You hear the shouts of drow voices, all the cottage stuff seems to be creating a massive distraction at least for now.
    • You hear drow shouting in confused Elvish, birds chirping, metal crashing, and other chaotic sounds from the wreckage of the Cottage swirling around several areas further away.
    • You also immediately see little spiders in the area hissing and coming for Sig, only a matter of time before bigger ones come!
  • As they fell out of the portal, Perry saw Agdon still back at the Cottage, dangling by his scarf and being left in the feywild, but Perry couldn’t see more than that.
  • As they spilled into Ilvara’s Quarters, hardly any time had passed since they were last here, even though their time in the feywild was much longer! Fresh dead bodies, maybe a day or so after the demon battle is all.
  • Shrump, Tueue, and the cat were given pet plot armor, no longer mechanically useful. Snoodle was not.
  • Topsy and Turvy were acting weird and huddling in the corner the whole time.
  • The Party found interesting papers written in elvish in Ilvara’s room on a desk. 
  • The cat was inspected. Nametag said “Whisper”, Sig renamed her Banksy. She had stitch seams especially in a chelsea grin from the cheeks, and was apparently a mix match of several taxidermy animals. Banksy loved Sig, hissed and low key wanted to kill anyone else for no reason. 
  • Kronk explored the Lieutenant's Quarters below, which had a tornado of rubble still spilling out from the rift in the planes. He unlocked Bav’s Cabinet, finding a tiny cauldron with a paper saying “spittlespew”.
  • Jibjib hid in chest, knowing the fight was a bad idea but failing to convince her teammates to take things cautiously.
  • Azaelith peeked upstairs and got spotted by Ilvara. He saw upstairs in the Shrine Room, Ilvara and 2 other powerful drow fighting and killing an Animated Armor and a Shadow from Bav’s Cottage.
  • Perry led the charge, jumping up to the Shrine Room to face the drow. A bald spellcaster drow had Spiritual Guardians cast around her. Azaelith and Sig followed Perry, right into the damaging spell’s radius. Both were KO’d soon after. 
  • Perry grabbed Sig and jumped back down to Ilvara’s Quarters below, unfortunately leaving Azaelith to be hauled away unconscious by the drow. 
  • The bald drow priestess jumped down to Ilvara’s quarters to hit everyone down there with her radius spell. Daterra Snared her and had her persuaded to help the Party!
  • But then Ilvara threw Insect Plague (flying spiders) down on them all from above, filling half the room with the damaging AoE. The bald drow was killed… Prince Derendil (the quaggoth who acted like an uppity elven prince) was killed… Perry was KO’d…
  • And Sigfried Thistlewhistle was killed by Ilvara’s spider plague, our first Player Character death!
  • Ilvara shouted back and forth with the Party in her quarters below from the Shrine room above, trapping them, demanding they surrender, then dropping manacles down for them to put on and come up peacefully. 
  • Jibjib suddenly and mysteriously laid his stuffed frog onto Sig’s dead body. A glow of eerie red light and warmth filled the room… and the deep gnome gasped and sat up, resurrected!
  • Some tried to deceive Ilvara. Jibjib was KO’d for not shackling himself correctly. Others manacled themselves and came up to surrender.
  • But suddenly Bavlorna cast a spell through Daterra’s hag eye, badly damaging Ilvara! Kronk took this opportunity and used his manacles to choke and snap the neck of a drow guard!
  • Perry grappled Ilvara and threw her with himself out the window into the webs below! Ilvara escaped with the Freedom of Movement spell. 
  • The rest of the Party ganged up and finally killed Ilvara’s lieutenant and 2nd in command, the powerful drow Shaiir Vandree.
  • But they weren't out of the woods yet. Perry was still in peril, struggling restrained in the webs below, surrounded by two giant spiders being partially lured away by the Lolth-cursed Sig shouting from the window above. Azaelith was still being dragged away somewhere, an unconscious prisoner of at least 1 drow and 1 quaggoth. And Ilvara was fleeing through the webs, injured but escaping.



Session 8 - “Dealing with Bav” 6/21/24

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib


  • The Party entered Bavlorna Blightstraw’s Cottage. They found her broken “Preservation Pool”, with nasty stagnant water. In the pool was a strange clogged well, a big standing mirror, and a floating lilypad. A Lornling (a tiny duplicate of Bav) was hiding and watching them, hopping away frantically when discovered by Sig. Mannequins with Bav’s patchwork clothing projects were in the corner of the room. When Jibjib grabbed one, a Darkmantle in disguise as a witch’s hat hopped onto Jib’s head and started biting and suffocating, even cracking Jib’s precious mask. They killed the creature quickly.
  • Next the Party explored Bav’s taxidermy workshop, finding all her horrific artistic creations. Perry found one of his marbles among an assortment of eyeball things.
